judul: Real-Time Mango Counting Using Ghost-YOLOv11: A Lightweight Object Detection Approach
sumber: 2nd Asian Conference on Intelligent Technologies Acoit 2025
abstrak: Agricultural yield estimation, like counting fruits such as mangoes, is a key and important job in farming. While advanced object detection models can be very accurate, they usually need a lot of computing power, making them hard to use on small devices like drones or robots. To solve this problem, we created Ghost-YOLOv11, a simpler and faster model designed for real-time use. We keep the macro architecture of the original model intact but comprehensively replace the standard Conv and C3k2 blocks with more efficient GhostConv and C3k2Ghost modules, based on the principles of GhostNet. We tested our model on the MangoYOLO dataset. Ghost-YOLOv11 uses about 28.7% fewer parameters (from 2.58 million to 1.84 million) and runs 33.8% faster (from 7.4 milliseconds to 4.9 milliseconds) compared to the original YOLOv11n. It also performs better in counting accuracy, with a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.773, which is better than YOLOv11m (0.814) and YOLOv11n (0.884).These results suggest that Ghost-YOLOv11 is a good choice because it balances speed, size, and accuracy for a variety of uses, especially opening up new frontiers in edge devices for automation tasks.
